Reproduced: webpack !! inline prefix skips configured postcss-loader so PurgeCSS never runs. Suggested postcss-loader in inline chain + PrimeVue content/safelist /^p-/. Labelled question.
Custom extractor /[\w-/:]+(?<!:)/g splits w-1.5, top-[3px], !mt-0 (verified). Suggested broader extractor + postcss-import first; asked for example class names.
